feeds.title: Artists Network
feeds.description: Artists Network, launched in 2007, is a vibrant online community that provides resources and inspiration for artists of all levels. Founded by Golden Peak Media, the platform offers a wealth of content, including instructional videos, articles, and tutorials across various mediums like watercolor, drawing, and oil painting. The editorial team features experienced artists and educators who contribute to its comprehensive library of artistic knowledge. Artists Network also hosts events, competitions, and workshops to foster creativity and learning within the art community.

feeds.title: How to Pastel
feeds.description: My love of pastel and the enjoyment I receive from teaching about pastel inspired the creation of this website. On it, I want to offer not only my own workshops both on- and off-line but also tips and reviews and opinions, and all manner of information regarding pastels, their use and pastels did through the years old and new.

feeds.title: Matte Shot - A tribute to Golden Era special fx
feeds.description: This blog authored by Peter Cook is intended primarily as a tribute to the inventiveness and ingenuity of the craft of the matte painter during Hollywoods' Golden Era.

feeds.title: Draw Paint Academy Blog
feeds.description: Want to learn how to draw and paint? You came to the right place! Draw Paint Academy will guide you through the confusing world of art. Articles provide you with high-level art education which is easy to understand.

feeds.title: Painting Perceptions
feeds.description: The Painting Perceptions blog was started in early 2009 by Larry Groff. This site started with an emphasis on painters who had some connection to observed vision in their work but over time the blog grew to become more inclusive; as much perceptions on painting as it is about perceptual painting. We examine a wide range of stylistic approaches from extremely loose abstraction to precise realism a

feeds.title: Gurney Journey
feeds.description: This daily weblog by Dinotopia creator James Gurney is for illustrators, plein-air painters, sketchers, comic artists, animators, art students, and writers. James Gurney wrote 'Color and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painter,' he also wrote and illustrated 'Dinotopia: A Land Apart from Time.

feeds.title: Lines and Colors
feeds.description: Lines and Colors is a blog about painting, drawing, sketching, illustration, comics, cartoons, webcomics, art history, concept art, gallery art, digital art, artist tools and techniques, motion graphics, animation, sci-fi and fantasy illustration, paleo art, storyboards, matte painting, 3d graphics and anything else.

feeds.title: Carol L. Douglas Blog
feeds.description: Find articles on Plein air painting, art, and the peripatetic life of the traveling artist - Carol. Carol Douglas paints and teaches in Rockport, Maine.She has taught workshops in Arizona, Maine, New Mexico, Florida, Texas, Massachusetts, and New York, and teaches twice annually aboard schooner American Eagle.

feeds.title: Mitchell Albala Blog
feeds.description: Mitchell Albala's semi-abstract and atmospheric landscapes have been exhibited nationally and in Seattle at Harris Harvery Gallery. His painting blog serves as a companion to his book, 'Landscape Painting: Essential Concepts and Techniques for Plein Air and Studio Practice', is a national bestseller.

feeds.title: Two Coats of Paint
feeds.description: Two Coats of Paint is an NYC-based art project, that includes an award-winning art blogazine, artists residency, social media services, Clubhouse conversations, catalog essays for painters, and other special initiatives.

feeds.title: David Dunlop & SimmonsArt Inc Blog
feeds.description: DAVID DUNLOP is a modern-day old master whose luminous landscapes draw from both Renaissance techniques and contemporary science. Follow the David Dunlop blog for new Painting workshop updates, live lecture series, and masterful tips on landscape paintings.

feeds.title: David Tanner Blog
feeds.description: David Tanner is a representational oil painter in Richmond, Virginia. David teaches oil painting at the Visual Arts Center of Richmond, where he was elected Master Teacher in 2006.

feeds.title: Jo Myers-Walker's Blog
feeds.description: Jo Myers-Walker have been an artist and art teacher for more than 40 years, working with people of all ages. Mostly into watercolors, she always exploring new techniques and materials.

feeds.title: Michael Chesley Johnson
feeds.description: Painter Michael Chesley Johnson explores the world of plein air painting, offering tips, suggestions, research, plus some great paintings!

feeds.title: René PleinAir
feeds.description: A Dutch artist very committed to painting every day directly from the subject without significant corrections, glazes or studio refinements. René's paintings have a faithfulness to nature & a sense of authenticity which is immediately striking.Despite René's difficult working conditions, there are many painterly subtleties to his oil paintings with interesting brushwork, rubbed, scraped & texture.

feeds.title: Holly Roberts One Painting at a Time
feeds.description: Holly Roberts a professional artist living and working in New Mexico who combine paint with photography and teach workshops around the country.

feeds.title: Robert Yonke Art
feeds.description: Robert Yonke is a Western Maryland and Florida based artist working in watercolor and mixed media. He works mostly in watercolor and focuses on subjects he loves, such as music, the mountains & the outdoors. Noted for his loose style with watercolors, Robert's art has been shown in many galleries throughout the region. He has been published in the Garrett County Art Council's Ginseng, Mid-Atlantic Fly Fishing Guide, Turkey Call Magazine and other publications.

feeds.title: Wed on Canvas Blog
feeds.description: The Wed on Canvas blog is a space where we are able to showcase our live wedding paintings. Live wedding and event painter, Ben Keys, will turn your wedding or event into a live event painting

feeds.title: 3D Wall printer Machine Blog
feeds.description: All you want to know about 3D automatic wall printing machine is here. we are the leading manufacturer of wall pinter in the world. KHR Technology is a leading manufacturer of 3D wall printing machine. We specialize in the development and production of automatic wall inkjet machines.

feeds.title: Ellie Harold Blog
feeds.description: Ellie Harold paints representational and abstract landscapes in oil. She facilitates workshops and gives painting instruction in Frankfort, MI, and Vieques, PR. Her art blog features regular creative discussions on Paintings techniques, excerpts from her books and other commentaries.

feeds.title: Carol Marine's Painting a Day
feeds.description: An oil painting blog Painting a Day by Carol Marine.

feeds.title: Qiang Huang A Daily Painter
feeds.description: Qiang Huang is an impressionistic, representational artist painting still life, landscape and figurative subjects.

feeds.title: William Schneider Blog
feeds.description: William works in oil and pastel. He views figures, landscape, or still life as opportunities to explore the effects of light on form. Painting from life, he seeks to capture the emotion of a particular moment and place. Sargent, Zorn, Fechin, and Sorolla have been his influences.

feeds.title: Ann McCann Fine Art
feeds.description: This site is for displaying Ann McCann's paintings.

feeds.title: Colors
feeds.description: MY THOUGHTS IN COLOUR. A blog about colors and paintings in watercolors and acrylics. Wonder why people choose to be colorless and rhythmless and not selfless in this colorful world full of rhythm..

feeds.title: Lakeland Art Blog
feeds.description: Lakeland art blog by Jane Ward, a landscape artist painting and living life in the Lake District

feeds.title: Tao Fine Art
feeds.description: Deidre Tao Fine Art is a place to share what she is working on in the studio. Deidre paint landscapes on canvas inspired by scenery in the New England area.

feeds.title: John McCoy Art Blog

feeds.title: Paintings by Blair

feeds.title: Paint and PAinting

feeds.title: Ryan Studio
feeds.description: Oil paintings by Abbey Ryan. He makes 'A Painting a Day'. His paintings have been featured in O, The Oprah Magazine's 'Live Your Best Life Women Who Make Beautiful Things,' Seth Godin's bestseller, Linchpin: Are You Indispensible?, and FOX's Good Day Philadelphia.

feeds.title: Mindi Oaten Art Blog
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Mindi Oaten. I am a prophetic artist working in acrylic on canvas. I am passionate about sharing my testimony in hopes I can teach and inspire others to see the Bible in a fresh way, as well as inspire and activate other creatives to use their gifts to glorify God. My goal is to create a visual expression to encourage and inspire those who see my work.

feeds.title: Watch Me Paint
feeds.description: Carol L. Douglas is a plein air, landscape and figure painter.She teaches out of her Rockport studio. She has taught in Maine, New Mexico and New York and shown in galleries across the United States.

feeds.title: PaintMyWalls Blog
feeds.description: PaintMyWalls Blog helps you to know more about the home painting and you can know the quality of our painting services. Paint My Walls offers you an experience to express yourself through your space, be it your house or your office. A professional design and painting company, we make your house into a home and convert your office into a space of comfort.

feeds.title: Karen Cooper Blog
feeds.description: Karen Cooper is a figurative painter, who paint with oil or acrylic paints on canvas. She do not make reproductions of any of my paintings, so each one that you look at is a unique rendering of her point of view.

feeds.title: Diane's Painting Blog

As a figurative artist, it is her goal to create an open-ended visual story that will engage the viewer. Visit Diane's Painting Blog to check out her work, painting tips, and inspiration along the way.

feeds.title: Asian Paints Nepal

feeds.title: David Schor Blog

feeds.title: Lee McVey Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Using pastels, Lee McVey creates landscapes people feel they can walk right into. Her love of nature began when she was a young girl walking in the woods with her grandparents. Those experiences have inspired Lee to focus on studio and plein air landscape painting.

feeds.title: Painting Thyme Needfuls

feeds.title: Caroline Goldsmith Blog
feeds.description: Landscapes painted in oils and acrylics painted en plein air and in studio from studies and interior subject matter by Caroline Goldsmith.

feeds.title: Pastel Artist Betsy Payne Cook Blog

Betsy's paintings depict her impressions of the landscape & its abundance of colors. She paints both en plein air & in her studio; & conveys her love of the outdoors n each painting.

feeds.title: The Next Artist
feeds.description: My Recent Paintings collection. Every artist was first an amateur.

feeds.title: Sonia Kane Blog
feeds.description: North Carolina artist Sonia Kane is a painter of sunlit moments. The 'oh wow' moments are the inspiration for her oil paintings as they remind her to linger and savor God's world.

feeds.title: Nancy Romanovsky Blog
feeds.description: Representational landscape painter specializing in aspen trees and forests. Her chosen medium is oil, with variety of brushwork, thick and thin, loose and detailed. It gives her the opportunity to portray the breadth and scale of nature.

feeds.description: Chris Brandley Art includes everything from painting commercial and residential murals and faux finishes, to painting oil on canvas. Ms. Brandley's paintings embrace a range of subjects, with her focus being on her expression of how a moment in time makes her feel, using light and vivid color.

feeds.title: Simon Bland Blog

There is an extensive collection of blog posts about art, working in the artists studio, works in progress and oil painting techniques

feeds.title: Jane Hunt Painting Blog
feeds.description: Based in Colorado, Jane Hunt frequently paints plein air, landscape oil painting inspired by the beautiful landscape surrounding me.

feeds.title: Vivianite
feeds.description: Vivianite is a portal for those of you who are interested in painting and painting related fine art. Its mission is to inspire, inform, provoke, motivate and open up for discussion.

feeds.title: Waking up to paint
feeds.description: Kelli Folsom is an award winning still life and landscape artist living in Oklahoma.

feeds.title: Jeni Caruana        . . . . . painting for joy Blog
feeds.description: A Malta-based artist Jeni Caruana paints live jazz musicians, dancers, nudes and landscapes. The subjects may change but her work always reflects the rhythm of movement and the song of life.

feeds.title: Painting Skies

feeds.title: Kelly Medford Blog

feeds.title: Frank Eber - Watercolor painting is my refuge, watercolor painting is my life!

feeds.title: Lena Rivo's Painting Blog
feeds.description: Lena Rivo uses color, value and composition to explore mood and emotion in her paintings and enjoys painting a variety of subjects including landscape, still life and figures, both in the studio and outdoor on location. She works directly from life to capture the qualities and nuances of natural light and color harmony.

feeds.title: Keith Bond Blog
feeds.description: Keith Bond is an award winning artist specializing in plein air and studio landscapes as well as large scale murals.

feeds.title: Mark Mitchell Paintings & Drawings Blog
feeds.description: Mark Mitchell specialises in 19th-21st century British & Continental Fine Art, comprising of still lifes, landscape, seascape, interior, portrait and animal paintings.

feeds.title: Painting Portrait Tips
feeds.description: In painting portrait tips Ben Lustenhouwerwill tell about my techniques, methods, and flesh colors. Also you will find his video tutorials 'How to paint a portrait'.

feeds.title: Cathleen Rehfeld
feeds.description: Cathleen Rehfeld an oil painter love doing small daily oil paintings. They have an immediate freshness about them. Whatever you are thinking about that day goes into them, almost like a visual diary. She love the creamy color and intense luscious look of oil paint, making brushstrokes that bring out that quality in the paint and try new ideas, colors, and subject matter.

feeds.title: Andrea Farah paintings
feeds.description: Digital & traditional paintings artworks by: Andrea Farah.

feeds.title: Jackson's Art Blog
feeds.description: Founded in London in 2000, Jackson's offers a vast range of art materials to artists from all over the world. Jackson's Art Blog is a friendly place for artists to talk about their work, techniques, and materials. With our expertise and knowledge and as a team of practicing artists, we are dedicated to helping you find the colors, surfaces, brushes, and tools that you need for your practice.

feeds.title: Paintings by Christine
feeds.description: Original paintings in oils, pastel, and acrylic for sale, still life, floral, abstract and landscape themes, by the artist in England, UK

feeds.title: Watermill blog » Painting Holidays
feeds.description: Our relaxing, inspiring and fun-filled painting courses with hand-picked internationally renowned tutors are designed to help both experienced painters and beginners to release their talent and most of all, enjoy their painting. We offer courses in watercolours, oils, pastels, acrylics and other media.
